subject.title: message-tool send mid-turn writes 'delivery-mirror' side-branch into transcript → permanent HTTP 400 loop, session silently dead

question: Should this mixed issue remain open as coordination for both the delivery-mirror fix and the Anthropic signed-thinking replay fix, or should it be closed once the remaining work is delegated to the narrower Anthropic replay issues?
rationale: Current main only resolves the delivery side-append half, while the follow-up signed-thinking failure is still represented by open issue and PR work; choosing the canonical tracking shape is maintainer coordination.

options.title: Close After Delegation
